record.field: Comprehensive appraisal review form tailored for Sales Managers, focusing on quota attainment, pipeline health, leadership, and customer relationships.

Sales Manager Performance & Self-Assessment

Period Review & Goal Evaluation

1. Revenue & Quota Attainment

  • What percentage of your sales target was achieved during this evaluation cycle?
  • Which key enterprise deals or market segments contributed most to your team's performance?
  • What challenges or market conditions impacted pipeline conversion rates?

2. Sales Strategy & Pipeline Leadership

  • How effectively did you manage pipeline hygiene, forecasting accuracy, and lead progression?
  • What new sales initiatives, pitch improvements, or account expansion strategies did you introduce?

3. Team Mentorship & People Development

  • How did you support underperforming account executives and nurture top sales talent?
  • What coaching, objection handling, or negotiation workshops did you conduct for your team?

4. Goals & Action Plan for Next Period

  • Top 3 commercial goals and target revenue numbers for the upcoming cycle:
  • Strategic skills, market certifications, or executive training required:

Manager Evaluation: Sales Manager

Executive Review & Leadership Assessment

1. Quantitative Performance Assessment

Evaluation of sales quota attainment, revenue growth, churn prevention, and forecast reliability.

2. Strategic & Operational Execution

Feedback on leadership presence, cross-functional collaboration (with Marketing & Product), and process discipline.

3. Summary Rating & Next Period Target Agreement

Overall strengths, growth areas, and agreed compensation / KPI milestone incentives.
Appraisal form designed for Design Interns and Junior Designers, focusing on craft skills, design system usage, learning agility, and feedback integration.

Design Intern Self-Assessment & Growth Review

Internship Milestones & Learning Reflection

1. Design Deliverables & Project Contributions

  • What projects, UI components, wireframes, or marketing graphics did you deliver this period?
  • Which project are you most proud of and why?

2. Technical Skills & Tool Mastery

  • How comfortable are you with Figma, Design Systems, Auto-Layout, and prototyping tools?
  • What design techniques or workflows did you learn during this internship?

3. Collaboration & Receiving Critique

  • How well did you incorporate design feedback from senior designers and stakeholders?
  • How effectively did you collaborate with frontend developers and product managers?

4. Career Goals & Next Learning Focus

  • What design domains (UI/UX research, motion design, design systems, visual branding) do you want to explore next?
  • What support or mentorship would help you transition into a full-time design role?

Mentor / Lead Review: Design Intern

Skill Development & Performance Appraisal

1. Quality of Craft & Attention to Detail

Assessment of visual hierarchy, component consistency, design handoff quality, and speed of delivery.

2. Learning Agility & Initiative

Feedback on curiosity, problem-solving independence, and responsiveness to critique.

3. Recommendation & Next Steps

Recommendation regarding internship completion, extension, or full-time offer readiness.
General appraisal template suitable for standard employee quarterly or annual reviews.

Employee Self-Assessment & Performance Review

1. Key Deliverables & Achievements

  • What were your principal achievements and completed goals during this evaluation period?
  • What obstacles did you encounter, and how did you resolve them?

2. Core Competencies & Quality of Work

  • How do you assess your quality of work, timeliness, and problem-solving effectiveness?
  • How did you demonstrate teamwork and positive communication across departments?

3. Development & Future Objectives

  • What are your top professional development priorities for the next cycle?
  • What skills, tools, or resources do you need from the company to succeed?

Manager Review & Feedback

1. Performance Against Objectives

Detailed assessment of milestone achievements and overall contribution to team goals.

2. Strengths & Areas for Improvement

Constructive feedback on key strengths and suggested developmental areas.

3. Development Plan & Goals Agreement

Agreed targets, milestones, and training plan for the upcoming period.
